content: Tanvi Saxena called insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to clarify details regarding her policy expiration date (30/09/2027) and the subsequent 15-day claim window ending on 15/10/2027. Sunita confirmed that services rendered on the final day of the policy are covered if filed within the window, and that the agent will set a reminder to reach out in August for renewal options.

action_items: Agent to set a reminder to reach out to the customer in August regarding renewal options
